method.beforeState: Shared clone of the baseline inside TMPDIR with its own copy of modules/ui-web/node_modules; no stash or revert.
method.runnerS: Vitest JSON startTime to the last file endTime, including the build in beforeAll.
method.alone: No load created by this session; other sessions on the 20-CPU machine kept a load average of about 3-7 throughout, so alone runs are not idle-machine runs.
method.load: Suite pinned with taskset to CPUs 0-3; two python busy loops pinned to CPUs 0 and 1, started and killed by PID by the same script; identical for before and after.
method.resources: Owned headless Chromium, loopback vite preview servers on port 0 and two CPU-load processes on this machine. No shared dev stack, owner app or CI.

equivalence.what: Every measured value of the legibility cases dumped (temporary instrumentation in the clones only) at the baseline (real keyboard and pointer input, fresh pages per palette) and at the candidate (protocol-forced states, shared pages where used), keyed by case and surface/forced/control/state.
equivalence.note: A first candidate that also shared connecting and factory reset across palettes and applied each palette to them differed on exactly those two surfaces (432 values): they paint before the saved palette is restored. They now boot per palette with that palette storage, as before, and all 5184 values match.

plantedDefects.how: BOOT_FRAME_TREE pointed at a shared clone of the baseline with one rule added to index.html; candidate test file; the 12 legibility cases run.

A-normal.rule: #window-controls button:active { color: var(--window-control-fill); } (after the hover/active rule, outside forced colours)

B-forced.note: Vitest printed one error per group of identical failures: the six dark cases share one (108 entries) and the six light cases another (108 entries).
